content: If the API Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus is called with DEM_DEBOUNCE_STATUS_RESET , it shall reset the related fault detection counter.
If the API Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus is called with DEM_DEBOUNCE_STATUS_RESET , it shall reset the related fault detection counter.
If the API Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus is called with DEM_DEBOUNCE_STATUS_RESET , it shall reset and freeze the related fault detection counter until the status of the event is reported again.
